title: Interaction with single-stranded DNA-binding protein modulates Escherichia coli RadD DNA repair activities
authors: Miguel A. Osorio Garcia; Elizabeth A. Wood; James L. Keck; Michael M. Cox
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细菌RadD与单链DNA结合蛋白SSB的互作及其对DNA修复功能的影响，属蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA结合建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The bacterial RadD enzyme is important for multiple genome maintenance pathways, including RecA DNA strand exchange and RecA-independent suppression of DNA crossover template switching. However, much remains unknown about the precise roles of RadD. One potential clue into RadD mechanisms is its direct interaction with the single-stranded DNA binding protein (SSB), which coats single-stranded DNA exposed during genome maintenance reactions in cells. Interaction with SSB stimulates the ATPase activity of RadD. To probe the mechanism and importance of RadD/SSB complex formation, we identified a pocket on RadD that is essential for binding SSB. In a mechanism shared with many other SSB-interacting proteins, RadD uses a hydrophobic pocket framed by basic residues to bind the C-terminal end of SSB. RadD variants that substitute acidic residues for basic residues in the SSB binding site impair RadD/SSB complex formation and eliminate SSB stimulation of RadD ATPase activity in vitro . Mutant E. coli strains carrying charge reversal radD changes display increased sensitivity to DNA damaging agents synergistically with deletions of radA and recG , although the phenotypes of the SSB-binding radD mutants are not as severe a full radD deletion. This suggests that RadD has multiple functions in the cell, with a subset requiring the interaction with SSB.
abstract_zh: 细菌RadD酶对于多种基因组维持途径至关重要，包括RecA DNA链交换以及不依赖RecA的DNA交叉模板切换抑制。然而，关于RadD的具体作用仍有许多未知之处。揭示RadD机制的一个潜在线索是其与单链DNA结合蛋白（SSB）的直接相互作用，该蛋白在细胞基因组维持反应中覆盖暴露的单链DNA。与SSB的相互作用刺激了RadD的ATPase活性。为了探究RadD/SSB复合物形成的机制及其重要性，我们鉴定了RadD上一个对结合SSB至关重要的口袋。在与许多其他SSB相互作用蛋白共享的机制中，RadD利用一个由碱性残基框定的疏水口袋来结合SSB的C末端。在SSB结合位点将碱性残基替换为酸性残基的RadD变体，在体外损害了RadD/SSB复合物的形成，并消除了SSB对RadD ATPase活性的刺激。携带电荷反转radD变化的突变大肠杆菌菌株，在与radA和recG缺失协同作用下，对DNA损伤剂的敏感性增加，尽管SSB结合radD突变体的表型不如完全radD缺失那么严重。这表明RadD在细胞中具有多种功能，其中一部分需要与SSB的相互作用。
